title: Controllable rheological properties of UV-responsive calix[4]arene gel for drug encapsulation and release
content:
RSC Adv., 2024, 14,39142-39146
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA06787H, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Ji Ha Lee, Wataru Kanda, Tomoyuki Tachibana, Minhye Kim, Sung Ho Jung, Riku Kawasaki, Akihiro Yabuki
This study investigates the potential of calix[4]arene-based supramolecular gels for use in drug delivery systems, focusing on both their rheological properties and controlled drug release behavior.
